question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a grey present, Bob has a teal present, Claire has a pink present, Dave has a blue present, Eve has a silver present, Fred has a gold present, and Gertrude has a red present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Eve and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. Finally, Eve and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Fred has the
Options:
(A) grey present
(B) teal present
(C) pink present
(D) blue present
(E) silver present
(F) gold present
(G) red present
solution:
Gift holders, in column order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: grey | teal | pink | blue | silver | gold | red
1. Eve ↔ Gertrude: grey | teal | pink | blue | red | gold | silver
2. Fred ↔ Gertrude: grey | teal | pink | blue | red | silver | gold
3. Gertrude ↔ Fred: grey | teal | pink | blue | red | gold | silver
4. Bob ↔ Dave: grey | blue | pink | teal | red | gold | silver
5. Alice ↔ Gertrude: silver | blue | pink | teal | red | gold | grey
6. Gertrude ↔ Fred: silver | blue | pink | teal | red | grey | gold
7. Eve ↔ Claire: silver | blue | red | teal | pink | grey | gold
Fred has the grey present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
